S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.

subtypes.Eating Very Small Amounts: Eating only one or two bites a day or extremely small portions per meal.
subtypes.Skipping Meals: Intentionally skipping breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
subtypes.Exclusion of Specific Food Groups: Strictly avoiding specific food groups like carbohydrates or fats to prevent nutritional imbalance.
subtypes.Strict Calorie Restriction: Limiting daily caloric intake to an extremely low level.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.

subtypes.Continuous Weight Loss: A state where weight continues to decrease due to intentional restriction of intake.
subtypes.Insistence on Low Weight: Attempting to lose more weight or refusing to restore weight despite already being underweight.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.

subtypes.Fear of Weight Gain: Extreme fear and loathing of gaining weight or becoming fat.
subtypes.Fear of Specific Foods: Fear that eating high-calorie foods will immediately lead to weight gain.
subtypes.Obsession with Weight Gain: Compulsively checking the scale and becoming extremely anxious about even the slightest increase.

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.

subtypes.Distorted Body Image: Perceiving one's body as much fatter than it actually is or perceiving specific parts as excessively large when looking in the mirror.
subtypes.Self-Worth Dependent on Weight: Judging whether one is a good or successful person solely based on weight or body shape.

S084.name: Low_Weight_Severity_Non_Recognition
S084.description: Persistent lack of recognition of the seriousness of the current low body weight.

subtypes.Denial of Medical Risk: Not admitting or dismissing the health risks caused by being underweight.
subtypes.Disregard of Symptoms: Not taking physical symptoms caused by low weight (dizziness, hair loss, amenorrhea) seriously.
subtypes.Dismissal of Concerns: Exaggerating or rejecting the concerns of doctors or family as unnecessary.

symptom.disease_info: Anorexia nervosa is an eating disorder characterized by persistent restriction of energy intake leading to significantly low body weight, intense fear of gaining weight or becoming fat, and a distorted perception of body weight or shape or an undue influence of weight/shape on self-evaluation. It often begins in adolescence or young adulthood but can emerge or recur later in life, and may follow a chronic, relapsing course if untreated. Individuals may deny the seriousness of their low weight and engage in rigid dietary rules, excessive exercise, or other weight-control behaviors, despite medical compromise. It is distinguished from other eating disorders by the presence of significantly low body weight and the centrality of weight loss and thinness in the person’s self-concept, even when binge eating or purging are absent.

patient.stressor: Pedro’s restrictive eating emerged gradually in the months after a difficult separation from his wife, a period when he was adjusting to living alone for the first time and managing increased responsibilities at his sales job. Without the familiar structure of shared meals and family gatherings, he began jogging longer distances and trimming portions under the guise of "getting back in shape" and presenting a more polished image to clients and potential partners. The more chaotic his emotional life felt, the more he leaned on rigid routines around food and exercise, finding a sense of control in tracking every bite and pound, even as his family in Little Havana quietly worried that he looked unwell and no longer enjoyed the traditional dishes he once loved to cook. His supervisor eventually commented on his gaunt appearance and decreased stamina on business trips, and after a faint episode following a morning run, Pedro agreed to see his primary care doctor; when he admitted he was constantly preoccupied with maintaining his lower weight despite already being very thin, he was referred for psychiatric assessment.
patient.chief_complaint: Lately I feel like my whole sense of whether I’m doing okay depends on keeping my body as lean as possible, and it’s starting to take over my life.

S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.
S043.manifestation: Most days I tell people I’m too busy to eat, but really I’m cutting my meals down to things like a plain coffee for breakfast and half a chicken breast for dinner, and if I go over the calorie number in my app I feel like I’ve completely lost control.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.
S044.manifestation: Even though my pants are hanging off me and my mom keeps saying I look like I did after that bad flu years ago, I keep thinking, “I could still tighten up a bit more,” instead of seeing that I’m already too thin.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.
S045.manifestation: If I even think about eating a pastelito or some arroz con frijoles like I used to, I get this rush of panic that it’s all going to show up on my stomach the next day and I’ll blow the lean image I’ve worked so hard for.

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.
S046.manifestation: When I’m out meeting clients or even just looking at myself in the mirror before work, it feels like whether I’m a failure or not comes down to how sharp my jawline looks and whether my shirt clings anywhere around my waist.

S084.name: Low_Weight_Severity_Non_Recognition
S084.description: Persistent lack of recognition of the seriousness of the current low body weight.
S084.manifestation: The doctors and my sister keep warning me about my weight and that fainting spell after my run, but in my head it just feels like they’re overreacting, because I still go to work, I still run, so how bad can it really be?

add_requirements.functional_impairment: On longer client days I end up lightheaded and have to cut meetings short or avoid business lunches altogether, and I’ve been turning down family get-togethers because I don’t want to deal with everyone commenting on how little I’m eating.
